change: lightgbm 127 leaves lr 0.1, 159 raw + 128 graph features, steps 1-35
lesson: validation 0.998 vs public 0.950: the test period drifts and validation cannot rank drift fixes

change: rank average with a deep random forest
hypothesis: two different tree models are more robust than one
lesson: the deep forest fits the training era too closely, blending it in drags the ranking down

change: drop top 15 train-vs-test features by adversarial importance
hypothesis: period-specific features mislead the model on test
lesson: the removed list contained strong predictors (feat_53, feat_52); looking different in test does not make a feature harmful

change: 31 leaves, lr 0.03, colsample 0.5, min_child_samples 50
hypothesis: a less sharp model extrapolates better
lesson: best file so far but within noise of E01

change: train on steps 15-35 only
hypothesis: recent behaviour is closer to the test period
lesson: dropping early steps loses more signal than it gains in recency

change: drop 8 features that shift > 1 std and have univariate auc within 0.1 of 0.5
hypothesis: only shifted and uninformative features should go
lesson: even a mild removal rule hurt; third removal attempt to lose

change: 15 leaves, lr 0.02, colsample 0.4, min_child_samples 100
lesson: smoothing past E04 does not help

change: adversarial importance weights sqrt(p/(1-p)), clipped
hypothesis: training rows resembling test should count more
lesson: importance weighting has no measurable effect

change: adversarial importance weights on the E01 model
hypothesis: same as E08 on the sharper model
lesson: confirms E08

change: drop top 30 adversarial features
lesson: removal family has lost every time, low priority

change: drop top 45 adversarial features
lesson: removal family has lost every time, low priority

change: E04 minus 15 adversarial features
lesson: combines a noise change with a losing one

change: E03 trained on steps 15-35
lesson: combines two losing changes

change: features replaced by percentile rank within each time step
lesson: validation collapses: absolute values carry the signal

change: row weights halve every 10 steps back
lesson: dropped from the queue after E05 lost

change: drop 31 features whose univariate auc flips or moves > 0.15 between steps 1-14 and 15-27
hypothesis: keep features with a stable relation to the label

change: E04 minus the 31 unstable features
hypothesis: same as E16 on the smoother model
lesson: stability-based removal is neutral to slightly negative; fourth removal rule without a gain, close the removal family

change: one round of pseudo-labels (p >= 0.9 illicit, p <= 0.01 licit, capped) on unlabelled and test rows
hypothesis: unlabelled rows add coverage of later steps
lesson: risk of reinforcing mistakes on drifted steps

change: stage 2 adds mean/max of neighbour stage-1 scores, stage-1 scores out-of-fold by time step
hypothesis: neighbours carry signal: test-edge score corr 0.23 vs label corr 0.55 on train edges
lesson: first clear gain: neighbour scores carry signal the single model misses; new best file and the base to build on

change: score = 0.5 global rank + 0.5 rank within its time step
hypothesis: E04 flags 0.4-2% of rows in steps 43-49 vs 3-14% in 36-42, late illicit rows may rank too low
lesson: within-step rescaling hurts on the leaderboard as well as validation; close within-step post-processing

change: edge-only nodes stand in the mean score of their other scored neighbours
hypothesis: 25% of test rows (3,891) see no neighbour score; bridging reaches 3,335 of them
lesson: coverage of test rows with a neighbour score rose from 74.6% to 96.4%, but predictions barely moved (spearman 0.9978 with E19, above the 0.995 waste threshold); stage 2 leans little on rows that lacked neighbour scores

change: second round: out-of-fold stage-2 scores replace stage-1 scores as neighbour inputs
hypothesis: better neighbour scores give better neighbour features
lesson: spearman 0.9863 with E19, different enough to upload

change: final stage 2 refitted with confident test rows as pseudo-labels (p >= 0.9, <= 0.01, capped)
hypothesis: rows from the test period itself teach the model that period
lesson: 579 illicit and 6,247 licit test rows pseudo-labelled; spearman 0.9860 with E19, different enough to upload
